value.heading: What first drew him to surgery
value.text: In a 2013 Orange County Register profile, Grover said his father, a general surgeon, exposed him to surgery throughout childhood. He said his interest in cosmetic surgery began in medical school. This is his account of the path that drew him to the field, not evidence of clinical outcomes.
